data.body: Landed evidence: Gerrit 1797 merged as 9bcc2fba1b after LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. Verify run 31851589360 completed successfully in 31m20s from 23:48:15Z to 00:19:35Z. Substantive gates finished in 29m22s; final vote dispatch then waited 1m46s for a runner and executed in 11s. macOS was the critical path: job 27m51s, comprising 41s setup/pre-suite gates, 22m44s default suite, 3m10s integration tier, and 1m16s teardown. Ubuntu pytest jobs finished in 9m24s, 9m50s, and 10m04s. Because this patch changed the mutation manifest itself, the fail-closed selector intentionally ran all shards; their job durations were next-batch 6m53s, push-policy 37s, reducer-processors 12m19s, signing 13m30s, gates 11m18s, compact-policy 34s, and validate 7m48s. All Ubuntu work was released by minute 18. This sample places substantive CI inside the 20-30 minute target; the 1m20s end-to-end overage is entirely explained by the post-gate vote-job queue plus its execution.
